title: The End of Automatic Growth
why: The US just became a country whose population trajectory is set annually by policy rather than automatically by fertility, like Canada or Australia, and the political system has not metabolized it.
hook: For two centuries American growth ran on births; immigration was the garnish. Around 2015 that quietly inverted, and in 2025 the new engine throttled by half in one year. What happens to a country when growth becomes a decision?
